service.name: PC Diagnosis
shortDescription: Professional PC hardware and software diagnosis
Identify the cause of PC performance and functionality issues
service.longDescription: Professional PC diagnosis service to identify hardware and software problems affecting your computer. Our technician performs a systematic inspection and diagnostic testing to identify the root cause of issues such as slow performance, crashes, startup problems, overheating, hardware failures and other PC-related concerns.

addons.name: Hardware Health Check
addons.description: Detailed inspection of major PC hardware components.

addons.name: Performance Testing
addons.description: Additional performance testing to identify slow or underperforming components.

addons.name: Temperature Check
addons.description: Check CPU, GPU and system temperatures for overheating issues.

addons.name: Diagnostic Report
addons.description: Detailed summary of identified issues and recommended solutions.

faqs.question: What problems can you diagnose?
faqs.answer: We can diagnose common hardware and software issues including slow performance, startup problems, crashes, overheating, driver issues and hardware failures.

faqs.question: Does PC diagnosis include repair?
faqs.answer: The diagnosis service identifies the problem. Any required repair, replacement parts or additional services may be charged separately.

faqs.question: Do I need to provide anything before the diagnosis?
faqs.answer: Please provide the PC and any relevant accessories such as the power adapter, monitor or other components needed for testing.

tools.name: PC Diagnostic Tool Kit
tools.description: Professional tools used to diagnose PC hardware and system issues.

tools.name: Hardware Diagnostic Software
tools.description: Diagnostic software used to test hardware health and system performance.

processSteps.title: Initial Inspection
processSteps.description: Our technician checks the PC, connected components and reported symptoms.

processSteps.title: Diagnostic Testing
processSteps.description: Hardware and software tests are performed to identify the source of the problem.

processSteps.title: Diagnosis & Recommendation
processSteps.description: We explain the identified issue and recommend the appropriate solution or repair.
